title: Spinnet Candidate Contract revision
description: The candidate.json that pins one revision of a Candidate Contract, published as candidates/<name>/r<revision>/candidate.json at the tag it names. The Host's own record of the revisions it provides is this file, and a test holds them equal. A published revision never changes: any change to its members, requirements or conflicts is a new revision.

base_level.description: The stable Plugin API Level the candidate adds to. A Plugin declaring the candidate must declare at least this api_level.

requires.description: Candidate revisions a Plugin must declare alongside this one.

conflicts.description: Candidates a Plugin may not declare alongside this one, by name.

members.description: What the candidate adds. Only a Plugin declaring this revision reaches them.

tag.description: The git tag pinning this revision's published material.

status.description: supported while the Host provides the revision; retired once it does not, with promoted_to_level when its members became that stable Level.
